historical_rejection: Task 'T2' references missing source 'tests/test_color.py' without a provider dependency. This task creates that path: put it only in writable_paths, not read_paths.

tasks.objective: Implement robust Color.fromHex in gpio_service/common/color.py that accepts exactly six ASCII hex digits (case-insensitive), optionally one leading '#', after surrounding whitespace stripping; all invalid inputs including nonstrings return a fresh white Color(255,255,255); no partial/trailing input acceptance; preserve constructor, toRGB (b,r,g) channel order, and generateRandom; no dependencies beyond standard library.
interface_contracts: Color.fromHex(hexStr) -> Color: static method; accepts any input; strips surrounding whitespace; optionally strips one leading '#'; validates exactly six ASCII hex digits (0-9, a-f, A-F); returns Color(r, g, b) for valid input; returns a fresh Color(255, 255, 255) for all invalid inputs including nonstrings, wrong lengths, non-hex characters, partial/trailing data; does not modify constructor, toRGB, or generateRandom.
acceptance_checks: fromHex('ff0000') returns Color(255, 0, 0) with r=255, g=0, b=0.
fromHex('#ff0000') returns Color(255, 0, 0) with r=255, g=0, b=0.
fromHex('FF0000') and fromHex('#Ff0000') return Color(255, 0, 0) (case-insensitive).
fromHex('  ff0000  ') and fromHex('  #ff0000  ') return Color(255, 0, 0) (whitespace stripped).
fromHex('ff000') (5 digits), fromHex('ff00000') (7 digits), fromHex('ff000000') (8 digits) each return a fresh Color(255, 255, 255).
fromHex('ff0000g') (trailing non-hex), fromHex('gg0000') (non-hex chars), fromHex('') (empty), fromHex('   ') (whitespace only) each return a fresh Color(255, 255, 255).
fromHex(123), fromHex(None), fromHex([1,2,3]) (nonstring inputs) each return a fresh Color(255, 255, 255).
Each invalid-input call returns a distinct object (not the same instance) with r=255, g=255, b=255.
toRGB() on a Color(255, 0, 0) returns (0, 255, 0) confirming (b, r, g) channel order is preserved.
generateRandom() still returns a Color with r, g, b in [0, 255] and is unaffected by fromHex changes.

tasks.objective: Add tests/test_color.py with at least six substantive pytest cases using real gpio_service.common.color.Color, covering bare and hash-prefixed non-default colors, mixed case, whitespace, malformed lengths/trailing data, invalid characters and nonstrings, fresh fallback objects, and existing channel order; tests must pass the new implementation and reject original and qualified faulty variants by assertions; no skips, dependency stubs, or test manipulation.
interface_contracts: tests/test_color.py imports Color from gpio_service.common.color and exercises Color.fromHex, Color.toRGB, and Color.generateRandom; all tests use real Color, no mocks or stubs; at least six substantive test functions; no pytest.skip or xfail; assertions verify exact r, g, b values and object identity for fallback cases.
acceptance_checks: At least six test functions exist in tests/test_color.py, each with meaningful assertions (no bare assert True or pass-only tests).
A test verifies fromHex('ff0000') returns Color with r=255, g=0, b=0.
A test verifies fromHex('#ff0000') returns Color with r=255, g=0, b=0.
A test verifies fromHex('FF0000') and fromHex('#Ff0000') return Color with r=255, g=0, b=0 (mixed case).
A test verifies fromHex('  ff0000  ') and fromHex('  #ff0000  ') return Color with r=255, g=0, b=0 (whitespace).
A test verifies fromHex('ff000'), fromHex('ff00000'), fromHex('ff000000') each return Color(255, 255, 255) (malformed lengths).
A test verifies fromHex('ff0000g'), fromHex('gg0000'), fromHex(''), fromHex('   ') each return Color(255, 255, 255) (invalid chars/trailing/empty).
A test verifies fromHex(123), fromHex(None), fromHex([1,2,3]) each return Color(255, 255, 255) (nonstrings).
A test verifies each invalid-input call returns a distinct object (id() differs) with r=255, g=255, b=255 (fresh fallback).
A test verifies toRGB() on Color(255, 0, 0) returns (0, 255, 0) confirming (b, r, g) channel order.
A test verifies generateRandom() returns a Color with 0 <= r, g, b <= 255.
No test uses pytest.skip, pytest.xfail, mock, stub, or manipulates Color internals; all tests import and use real gpio_service.common.color.Color.

proposal.rationale: Policy is sufficient: requirements specify exact parsing rules (six ASCII hex digits, case-insensitive, optional leading '#', whitespace stripping, fresh white fallback for all invalid inputs including nonstrings, no partial/trailing acceptance) and test requirements (at least six substantive pytest cases, real Color, no skips/stubs, must reject faulty variants). The source file gpio_service/common/color.py is available and shows the current fromHex implementation, constructor, toRGB (b,r,g order), and generateRandom. Two tasks: T1 implements the robust fromHex; T2 adds tests/test_color.py. T2 depends on T1 because tests must pass the new implementation. Interface contracts state the AFTER-change signature and behavior. Acceptance checks cover all requirement aspects with exact assertions. No blocking questions needed; all product policy is specified. Routine choices: use standard library only (re or manual parsing), no new dependencies; tests use pytest as specified; channel order (b,r,g) in toRGB is preserved as-is.
